spans.s:
m. (-धः)
A bank, a shore.
E.
रुध to obstruct, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Impeding, that which impedes or obstructs, an obstacle, a hinderer or hindrance.
m. (-नः)
The planet MERCURY.
n. (-नं)
1 Impeding, obstructing.
2 Besieging, blockading.
E.
रुध to obstruct, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-क्रा)
A river.
E.
रोध a bank, and वक्र the course of a stream, fem. form.

n. (-धः)
A bank, a shore.
E.
रुध to obstruct, and असुन् aff.

f. (-क्रा)
A river.
E.
रोधस् a bank, and वक्र winding course.

m. (-ध्रः)
A tree, commonly Lodh.
n. (-घ्रं)
1 Offence, transgression.
2 Sin.
E.
रुध to obstruct, and रन् aff.
